admission.justification: A record under the wrong name would let a forged or misfiled generation stand in for another generation's terminal evidence when a master is judged ready to retire or an enclosure archived.

applicability: A retained lifecycle operation record read as terminal evidence.
conditions: Its content must match the canonical file name it is stored under.
statement: A retained lifecycle operation record is accepted by the terminal evidence reader only when its content matches the canonical file name it is stored under.
